# Aira

> Aira — AI concierge, Algarve. Aira builds AI voice and chat concierges for hotels, salons and small businesses in Portugal (Aira Concierge, Aira Assistant, Aira Admin), and runs Aira Home — four local services for property owners in the Algarve, answered 24/7 by Aira's AI concierge and delivered by local crews.

Aira is built and operated by Horizonte Solene Lda, based in Portimão, Algarve, Portugal.

## Aira Home — four services for property owners in the Algarve

Hub: https://aira-ai.net/home/
One phone for all four services: +351 308 800 687 (24/7). WhatsApp: +351 936 800 000. Email: info@aira-ai.net.
Languages: English, German, French, Portuguese.
Coverage: the Algarve — Luz, Lagos, Portimão, Carvoeiro, Lagoa, Silves, Armação de Pêra, Albufeira, Vilamoura. Aira Construction also works in Lisbon.

- [Airahome](https://aira-ai.net/airahome): 24/7 emergency home-repair callout — plumbing, electrical, locks & keys, appliances, air conditioning, furniture, general repairs. Emergency (2–3 h) €300, same day €150, scheduled €50 — each covers the first hour incl. travel and diagnosis, then €35/h. Price confirmed before anyone drives out.
- [Aira Energia](https://aira-ai.net/energia): free electricity bill check, savings calculator, tariff switching, solar panels and a licensed electrician in the Algarve.
- [Aira Garden](https://aira-ai.net/garden): wireless smart irrigation for the whole property — no trenching, works offline; consultation and quote.
- [Aira Construction](https://aira-ai.net/construction): renovation and finishing works by our own crew — demolition, walls, floors, bathrooms, kitchens, electrics, final cleaning. Algarve and Lisbon. Quote after a visit.

How to request: call +351 308 800 687, message on WhatsApp, use the chat on any Aira Home page, or the request form on each service page.

## Aira for businesses

- [Aira Concierge](https://aira-ai.net/concierge): AI voice receptionist for hotels — answers guest calls, handles bookings and requests, in multiple languages, 24/7.
- [Aira Assistant](https://aira-ai.net/assistant): AI executive/personal assistant agent handling calls, scheduling and messages.
- [Aira Admin](https://aira-ai.net/admin): AI receptionist for beauty and wellness studios.

Aira agents run on ElevenLabs conversational voice technology with custom automation (n8n) for booking, CRM updates and follow-up.
